situation: My coworker Sam told me privately over DM that she's been diagnosed with MS and will have a lot of appointments. Same team, not super close.
reply: Thank you for trusting me with that, Sam. I'm really sorry. If it helps, I can take the Thursday client check-ins whenever you're at an appointment, just send me the dates. It stays with me.
note: Workplace version: warmth, one practical offer, and privacy. No questions about the diagnosis.

situation: 我妈刚打电话说体检查出甲状腺结节，要做穿刺，她语气挺害怕的。我在外地工作，想挂了电话再给她发条微信。
reply: 妈，谢谢您第一时间告诉我。我已经请好假了，下周三回家，做穿刺那天我陪您一起去。有什么事我们一起面对。爱您。
note: 对方害怕时就稳一点，给一个具体的行动，不要追问病情细节。

situation: My friend told me she has breast cancer and I blurted out that my aunt died of it. I feel awful and want to fix it.
reply: I've been thinking about what I said about my aunt, and it wasn't what you needed to hear. I'm sorry. I'm here, I'll follow your lead, and I'm still bringing dinner on Thursday unless you tell me otherwise.
note: One line of ownership, then back to her. A long apology makes her comfort you.

situation: My friend Hannah has long COVID and just cancelled our dinner for the third time. She texted 'I'm so sorry, I feel like the worst friend, my body just won't cooperate.' I'm not upset, I want her to know that.
reply: You're not the worst friend, not even close. I'm sorry your body's making everything this hard. No apologising for cancelling, ever. I'll keep inviting you, and if a sofa and a takeaway at yours sounds more doable, I'm free Saturday. No need to reply tonight.
note: Release her from the guilt first, then offer a lower-energy version of the plan instead of just rescheduling the same one.

situation: Mi amigo Javi me escribió por WhatsApp: 'Me han encontrado un tumor, casi seguro benigno, me operan el 14 de octubre. Lo bueno es que ya tengo excusa para no ir a la cena de empresa.' Quiero contestarle bien.
reply: Solo tú podrías anunciar una operación con un chiste sobre la cena de empresa. Siento mucho que estés pasando por esto, y me apunto al humor negro todo lo que haga falta. También me apunto a llevarte al hospital el 14 y a recogerte después, solo dime la hora. No hace falta que contestes esta noche.
note: Si lo cuenta con humor, acompaña el tono, pero sin quitarle peso: reconoce la noticia, ofrece algo concreto con fecha y libéralo de contestar.

situation: 我带的组员小何私聊我，说确诊了中度抑郁，医生建议休息两周，想从下周一开始请假。她不想让组里其他人知道原因。
reply: 谢谢你愿意告诉我，这不容易。你安心休息，假我批了，10月5号到16号。手上的月报我安排别人接，你把在跟的事列个简单清单发我就行，不用写得很细。组里我只说你请假，不会提原因。想聊或者需要什么随时找我，不回消息也完全没关系。
note: 上级回应下属的健康消息：先接住，再把假期、交接、保密一次说清，最后给她不用回复的自由。

situation: My brother-in-law Dan told the family in August he has stage 3 colon cancer and started chemo. Everyone texted that first week, now it's gone quiet. He hasn't answered my last two messages.
reply: Thinking of you today, Dan. No need to reply. I'm dropping a lasagne on your porch Saturday around noon, and I won't knock unless you text me to.
note: Weeks in, silence is usually exhaustion: keep sending short no-reply messages with one concrete thing, and never ask why he's gone quiet.

situation: My friend Priya had a mastectomy two weeks ago. I've texted a few times and she just replied: 'Thank you, I love you, but I need to go quiet for a while and not talk about it.' I don't want to disappear, but I want to respect it.
reply: Of course, Priya. Thank you for telling me what you need. I'll go quiet, and I'm still right here. Unless you tell me otherwise, I'll send one short hello in early November, with no reply needed then either. Love you.
note: When they ask for space, honour it in a few words and name when you'll check back, so quiet never turns into disappearing.

situation: My friend Kelly posted on Facebook that her son Noah (6) was just diagnosed with type 1 diabetes and they're in the children's hospital until Friday learning to manage it. Our kids are in the same class, and her older daughter Ava is in 4th grade at the same school. I want to message her.
reply: Kelly, I just saw your post about Noah. I'm so sorry, what a week for all of you. I'll take Ava to and from school for the rest of the week, so that's one thing off your list; just tell me if you'd rather I didn't. Otherwise no need to reply.
note: When it's a child's diagnosis, the parent is the one you support: a practical offer that happens by default, and no questions about the medical side.

situation: 好朋友小敏的老公上周五突然中风，现在还在ICU，她一个人在医院守着，两个孩子暂时托给婆婆。她今天在群里简单说了一句情况，我想私信她。
reply: 小敏，刚看到你说的，太突然了，心疼你。谢谢你告诉我们。这周六我可以去你婆婆家接两个孩子出来玩半天，让老人歇一歇，你同意我就直接跟婆婆约时间。不用回我，等你有空再说。
note: 照顾者同样需要被看见：不问病情细节，给一个具体的帮忙，并免去她回复的负担。

situation: 我跟我爸五六年没怎么联系了，他再婚后关系一直很淡。今天他突然发微信说查出肺癌，下个月在成都做手术，就这一句。我不知道怎么回，但不想装没看见。
reply: 爸，谢谢你告诉我。听到这个消息我很难过。这周六晚上8点左右我给你打个电话，不想接也没关系，这条也不用回。手术日子定了告诉我一声，我想过去陪你一两天。
note: 关系疏远时不用补上这些年，也不追问病情；先接住消息，给一个小而具体的动作，主动权留给他。

situation: My manager, Karen, emailed our team of eight that she's been diagnosed with breast cancer, starts treatment next week and will be on reduced hours through December. I want to reply to her privately, not reply-all.
reply: Karen, thank you for telling us so openly, and I'm really sorry you're facing this. On the work side, I'm happy to run the Monday team meeting and cover the vendor calls while you're on reduced hours, just say the word. No need to reply to this. Thinking of you.
note: Upward, keep it short: warmth, one practical offer within your role, no questions about the diagnosis, and nothing that needs an answer.

situation: My close friend Owen texted that he's checking into a 28-day residential program for his drinking on Monday. He said only his sister and I know, and asked me not to tell anyone. We've been friends since school.
reply: Owen, thank you for telling me. That took guts, and I'm really proud of you. It stays with me. I can have Rufus for the 28 days, or pop round to water the plants and grab your post, whichever helps; just tell me which. No need to reply tonight.
note: Treat it like any health news: thanks, privacy said out loud, one practical offer, and no questions about how bad it got.
